Definition
[immersion; embedding; submanifold]

↗ def:dc-ch0-2-5 ↗ def:dc-ch0-2-8

1. ch0:3.1Let $M^m,N^n$ be differentiable manifolds. A differentiable $\varphi :M\to N$ is an immersion if $d\varphi _p:T_pM\to T_{\varphi (p)}N$ is injective for all $p\in M$. If in addition $\varphi $ is a homeomorphism onto $\varphi (M)\subset N$ (subspace topology), $\varphi $ is an embedding. If $M\subset N$ and the inclusion $i:M\subset N$ is an embedding, $M$ is a submanifold of $N$. If $\varphi :M^m\to N^n$ is an immersion then $m\le n$; the difference $n-m$ is the codimension.
